content:
elaine: Quick design review — putting this here before the sync. I pushed an updated Figma for the sidepane regrouping and some routing notes. TL;DR: consolidate Models + Deployments under 'Workloads', move Settings down, add explicit breadcrumb behavior for deep links.

sam: nice. can you call out the deep link pattern? worried about breaking existing bookmarks. :eyes:

matt: agreed on backwards compat. if we change top-level slugs we should keep redirects. small question: do we want /projects/:id/models to open the models list or the previously selected model?

elaine: good Q. idea is deep link maps to state: if URL has /models/:modelId -> open model detail; if just /models -> models list. fallback: if modelId not found, show list + in-page toast error.

sophie: for accessibility - breadcrumbs need aria-current on the last crumb and a visible focus outline when keyboard-navigating. also confirm that collapse/expand of groups is keyboard operable.

julian: re: URL routing, propose this pattern: 
```
/apps/:appId/overview
/apps/:appId/workloads/models
/apps/:appId/workloads/deployments
/apps/:appId/settings
```
This keeps 'workloads' as the grouping slug.

sam: that looks clean. how do we handle cross-app deep links (like a permalink to a model without app context)? some of our APIs return modelId only.

elaine: two options: 1) canonicalize to /apps/:inferredApp/models/:id using server-side mapping or 2) use a query param /models/:id?app=:appId. prefer 1 for cleaner URLs but requires lookup service.

matt: server-side mapping seems fine if we cache. fallback to redirect page if ambiguous. also add a short-lived redirect header for old slugs.

design-bot: screenshot uploaded (figma://file/0abcd123)

julian: copy nit — in the breadcrumb the second level currently says "Workloads". can we make it "Workloads (beta)"? maybe avoid parentheses in breadcrumb, consider a badge instead.

sophie: +1 on badge for visual affordance, but avoid adding too many visual elements in the breadcrumb row. badge should be announced by screen readers (aria-label).

elaine: implementation notes for eng: 1) add router aliases for legacy slugs 2) ensure server returns 302 for known-deprecated routes 3) expose a lightweight lookup endpoint /v1/resolve-model -> {appId, modelId} for cross-app permalinks 4) keyboard tests for pane toggles.

sam: can you add a small migration plan in the PR description? include which clients rely on old paths (console, CLI, docs).

matt: also add telemetry events for when a redirect happens so we can measure breakage.

elaine: will do. final question for y'all — do we collapse 'Telemetry' into Settings or leave as a top-level? current proposal collapses it.

sophie: collapse into Settings from an IA POV. make telemetry pages discoverable via search and settings index.

julian: fine with collapse. maybe add a quick link in the sidepane header for power users.

elaine: thanks — i'll update figma and open a draft PR with routing table + redirect map. tagging for followups: @sam for routing logic, @matt for redirects, @sophie for a11y review. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks, looking forward to the PR.

matt: :shipit: when tests pass.

sophie: happy to review a11y checklist.
